task.description:
Design for REQ-069 (the tenant file format sai-picker-tenant/3 with the `look` section, and `picker check` accepting it). Read first: the block REQ-069 in docs/requirements.yaml (all criteria are binding; the was→became table of the guard tests QS-1..12 and the model tests is part of it), decisions/0083, 0084 (all items and sections), 0082, 0066, 0070, 0071, 0072, 0076 (control chars in tenant texts), the approved sample docs/design/samples/picker-v3-approved-2026-10-26/ (data.js, office.js: the shape of the look data, the 15 object ids, colours, the four staff), the existing tenant format code in tools/src/picker/ (the check, the validators, error codes, demo tenants) and its tests, docs/design/REQ-057-picker-page.md as the style example, the guard tests in tools/test (picker-page-static.test.js and others named in the REQ-069 table).
Produce the design document docs/design/REQ-069-tenant-look-format.md following the sections of the earlier design documents: files to create and change with exact paths; the data shapes (look section: name on the door, mark letter, accent colours light and dark as #rrggbb, closed catalogue of 15 object ids, four staff with figures and role null/key rule, estimate fields are NOT in this requirement unless the block says so; the fallback look for /1 and /2 files as one pure shared module with no texts.js keys, per 0084 item 17); validation rules and error codes (reuse the ten existing codes, no new code unless the block says); the shared module's public functions with signatures and the result shape; the criterion→test table with test ids and the files; the was→became table of guard tests with the intent of each ban kept; mutants of the new logic; failure paths with unchanged state; sub-steps (BACKEND-DEV order, the advice in the block); open questions for ORCH (plain). Design only: no implementation code, no tests code, interfaces and shapes only. The two new tenants of /3 come in REQ-070, not here: say exactly what stand files this run needs (sample files in test fixtures only). Keep the owner's hard rules: nothing about the reference projects in files, no machine paths, no other projects' names. Language of the document: English (decisions/0080). Handoff text must have no machine paths or project names (say "the traces list").

result.summary: Designed REQ-069 in docs/design/REQ-069-tenant-look-format.md (sections 0-18, 802 lines, English). Format /3 = /2 plus a required look section (mark, optional tagline, industry, headline, colors light/dark with accent and accent2 as lower-case #rrggbb, exactly four staff with name, role, says, figure f01..f12, shirt accent/accent2/ink), optional desk and chips on questions, optional object on options (closed catalogue of 15 ids with a parameter table), and leads additions (telegram, whatsapp, max_per_hour, max_stored). No new error code: the ten codes, 36 Russian messages in a catalogue (each at most 18 words in the whole text, as the shape check of the tests counts it). Contrast rule: at least 3.0 : 1 against the sheet of the same theme, sheets #f3f5f9 and #161f2e (open question). One pure shared module public/tenant-look.js (catalogues, colour test, contrast, fallback look, desk rule, no texts.js keys); two new core files, shape.js (a pure move of four helpers out of validate.js) and v3-check.js (all /3-only checks); public-data.js gets publicLook and lookOfView (one entry for the look of any tenant, REQ-064/077/078); the registry record and server.js/tenants.js/engine.js do not change. The answers for the two /2 demo tenants stay byte-identical (six sha256 measured on the tag). Guard tests: a sketch with the real code turned exactly seven old tests red (PK-2a, PK-6e, PK-7c, PE-8d, LG-1c, LG-1c2, QS-1); the was-to-became tables (A: red, B: kept protecting, C: no edit, D: the twelve page-test rows, rows 1, 5, 7 act now) keep every ban. 89 samples listed with exact expected lines, 56 mutants, build sub-steps 69a-69f with the expected red set after each, criterion-to-test table, full quality bar section Q1-Q14 and R1-R3. This run needs no stand file in the product tree: samples are test fixtures only.

issues.text: O1 (needs an ORCH answer before the design gate). Criterion 3 requires an error for the string url(http://x) in the name of a staff member, but the description gives the name only 'one line, 1-30 signs' and the text rules accept this string. Written default (D10, message M14): a name is letters, combining marks, decimal digits, space, hyphen, apostrophe and dot; a breach is E_FIELD. Alternative: a WF-01 micro-amendment that removes the staff name from that sentence of the criterion. Proposal: the default, recorded in decisions/0085.

O2. Criterion 3 says an object of an option is accepted for a question of any of the three types, but a number question has no options in /1, /2 and /3 (options on a number question is E_FIELD). Written default: object is accepted on options of single and multiple questions, options of a number question stay E_FIELD; checkOfficeObject is exported so that REQ-073 can reuse it for number ranges. Proposal: a WF-01 micro-amendment of the phrase.

O3. The two sheet colours (the page style of the new office does not exist yet). Written default: light #f3f5f9 and dark #161f2e, the values of --page (light) and --surface (dark) of the released page style sheet. If the interface description of REQ-071 chooses other surfaces, two literals and one test row change. Effect measured: the approved sample's light accent #e0731f has 2.90 : 1 on the light sheet (fails) and its second sample's #5b3fd6 has 2.46 : 1 on the dark sheet (fails); REQ-070 must use a darker light accent and a lighter dark accent.

O4. Row 12 of the page-test table (QS-12) is listed by the requirement for later files (scene, flow, receipt, request) but this requirement adds picker-look test files that the old pattern does not see. Written default: QS-12 is widened now (all picker-*.js in tools/test, at least 25 files; nothing weakened). Alternative: leave row 12 for the next requirement.
Record decisions/0085-picker-look-format-conventions.md (Q12) with D1-D17 of the design section 2 and the answers to O1-O4; written by ORCH.

Two entries for the mistakes log (Q13), section 16.3: a criterion that demands an error for an input the description accepts (staff name, options of a number question); a sample file named with a word that show() hides prints the name as (скрыто).

Facts for the next requirements: REQ-064/077/078 should call lookOfView(entry.views.get(lang)); REQ-059 reads max_per_hour, max_stored, whatsapp and contact_fields from the registry view, not from the public questionnaire; REQ-070 needs no file from this run except the rule of section 5 and F11; this run adds no stand file to the product tree (design 10.4).

The test step must obtain the six sha256 values of design F4 again on the tag (the criterion says so); the design gives them as control values. The property test through the real command takes about 37 s (D16).
